method: Each target lock was generated with the committed direct pins using uv 0.10.12, Python 3.12 compatibility, the exact target triple, --generate-hashes, --only-binary :all:, --no-sources, and the official PyPI simple index. Runtime staging uses --require-hashes, --no-deps, and --only-binary :all:, so it cannot resolve, build, or add packages dynamically.
